title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: breakout room support
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned rollout and the newer Android release documentation, including their differing timelines. The PowerShell control and product licensing are supported; Android-specific participation controls and licensing details remain appropriately qualified.

### -AllowBreakoutRooms
Set to true to enable Breakout Rooms, set to false to disable the Breakout Rooms functionality.
Type: Boolean
### -Identity
Specify the name of the policy being created.
